architecture_summary: Modular React SPA. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. React Router v6 for navigation. Tailwind CSS for styling. No state management library (use React context for global state). API client in src/api/.

tickets.title: Build Beranda (Home) page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch beranda_home screen to React. Extract reusable components (HeroBanner, ProductCard, EventCard). Use Tailwind for styling. Match design pixel-perfect.

tickets.title: Build Masuk (Login) and Daftar Akun (Register) pages
tickets.description: Create login and registration pages. Form validation for email, password, phone. Error states for invalid inputs. Success redirect to Beranda.
acceptance_criteria: Forms submit to mock API endpoint

tickets.title: Build Detail Produk (Product Detail) and Detail Event Katalog (Event Detail) pages
tickets.description: Product and event detail pages. Dynamic content from mock API. Add to cart/button states. Image gallery component.
acceptance_criteria: Add to cart button states work

tickets.title: Build Pesanan Saya (My Orders) flow
tickets.description: Order listing, review, success, detail, and cancellation request pages. Order status badges. Cancellation form with validation.
acceptance_criteria: Order list renders with status badges

tickets.title: Build Upload Bukti Pembayaran (Payment Proof) and Schedule Calendar pages
tickets.description: Payment proof upload page with file validation. Calendar page for event scheduling. Date picker component.

tickets.title: Build Notifikasi (Notifications) and Admin Dashboard Overview pages
tickets.description: Notifications page with read/unread states. Admin dashboard with stats and recent activity. Notification badge component.

tickets.title: Build Welcome Screen page
tickets.description: Welcome screen with onboarding flow. Language selection. Get started button. Background image/video component.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Main app shell with responsive navigation. React Router v6 setup. Route configuration for all pages. Auth guard for protected routes. 404 page.
